newsitem.title: UK: UK monetary meet set for Monday afternoon -sources.
newsitem.headline: UK monetary meet set for Monday afternoon -sources.

text.p: The UK's monthly monetary policy meeting between Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke and Bank of England Governor Eddie George will start early on Monday afternoon, official sources said on Friday.
"We don't yet have an exact time but the meeting will be starting early in the afternoon," the source said.
Traders said they would not expect the Bank of England to signal any change in interest rates, should a change in policy be decided upon, until its money market operations early on Tuesday.
